record.original_question: Are there constructions of (n + 1)-polytopes from n-polytopes whose resulting symmetry type graphs differ from the families produced in Theorem 4.2 and from their duals?

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Are there constructions of (n + 1)-polytopes P from n-polytopes where the symmetry type graph of P is different from those in Theorem 4.2 and from their duals?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An abstract n-polytope is a graded poset (with elements called faces, ranked from -1 to n) satisfying the standard diamond, flag-connectedness, and strong flag-connectedness conditions of abstract polytope theory. The flag graph of an n-polytope P has the flags of P as vertices, with edges colored 0,1,...,n-1, where two flags are joined by an edge of color i whenever they differ exactly in their rank-i face. The automorphism group Γ(P) acts on flags preserving the edge coloring, and the symmetry type graph T(P) is the quotient of the flag graph by this action: its vertices are the flag-orbits of Γ(P), and edges are colored 0,...,n-1, possibly including semi-edges (loops indicating that an i-adjacent flag lies in the same orbit). The dual of a symmetry type graph is obtained by reversing the order of the colors 0,...,n-1.

Suppose one is given a family of constructions producing, from each n-polytope P, an (n+1)-polytope P′ whose facets or other structure is related to P, and suppose Theorem 4.2 (assume given) describes a fixed finite list F of possible symmetry type graphs (parametrized in n) realized by all known such constructions, together with the duals of the graphs in F.

Question: Does there exist a construction that, from some n-polytope P, produces an (n+1)-polytope P′ whose symmetry type graph T(P′) is not isomorphic (as an edge-colored graph with semi-edges) to any graph in F or to the dual of any graph in F?

artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not return a definitive resolution of this specific problem about whether constructions of (n+1)-polytopes from n-polytopes can yield symmetry type graphs outside the listed families and their duals. Related work by Pellicer, Potočnik and Toledo on 2-orbit maniplexes and extensions of polytopes has appeared, and some 2-orbit maniplexes have been shown to be polytopes, but no source clearly settles this question in the affirmative or negative.

status_evidence.title: Symmetry Type Graphs of Polytopes and Maniplexes
status_evidence.snippet: Defines symmetry type graphs for polytopes/maniplexes and studies their properties.
status_evidence.claim: Provides background framework but does not resolve the construction question.

status_evidence.title: Polytopality of 2-orbit maniplexes (Mochán)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies whether 2-orbit maniplexes constructed by Pellicer-Potočnik-Toledo are polytopes.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work, but does not directly enumerate symmetry type graphs from extension constructions.

status_evidence.title: On the Schläfli symbol of chiral extensions of polytopes (Montero)
status_evidence.claim: Provides extension constructions related to the question, without explicit claim about symmetry type graphs being new.
